import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_MOD_N = 1024000;
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static Mod[] fact = new Mod[MAX_MOD_N];
    static Mod[] factinv = new Mod[MAX_MOD_N];
    static Map<Integer, Integer> mp = new HashMap<>();

    static class Mod {
        int num;

        public Mod() {
            this.num = 0;
        }

        public Mod(long n) {
            this.num = (int)((n % mod + mod) % mod);
        }

        public Mod(int n) {
            this.num = n;
        }

        public static Mod operatorPlus(Mod a, Mod b) {
            return new Mod((a.num + b.num) % mod);
        }

        public static Mod operatorPlusLong(long a, Mod b) {
            return new Mod(a) + b;
        }

        public static Mod operatorPlusLong(Mod a, long b) {
            return new Mod(b) + a;
        }

        public static Mod operatorMinus(Mod a, Mod b) {
            return new Mod((mod + a.num - b.num) % mod);
        }

        public static Mod operatorMinusLong(long a, Mod b) {
            return new Mod(a) - b;
        }

        public static Mod operatorTimes(Mod a, Mod b) {
            return new Mod(((long)a.num * b.num) % mod);
        }

        public static Mod operatorTimesLong(long a, Mod b) {
            return new Mod(a) * b;
        }

        public static Mod operatorTimesMod(Mod a, long b) {
            return new Mod(b) * a;
        }

        public static Mod operatorTimesInt(Mod a, int b) {
            return new Mod(b) * a;
        }

        public static Mod operatorPlusAssign(Mod a, Mod b) {
            return a.operatorPlus(b);
        }

        public static Mod operatorMinusAssign(Mod a, Mod b) {
            return a.operatorMinus(b);
        }

        public static Mod operatorTimesAssign(Mod a, Mod b) {
            return a.operatorTimes(b);
        }

        public static Mod operatorTimesAssignLong(Mod a, long b) {
            return a.operatorTimesLong(b);
        }

        public static Mod operatorTimesAssignMod(Mod a, long b) {
            return a.operatorTimesMod(b);
        }

        public static Mod operatorPow(Mod a, int n) {
            if (n == 0) return new Mod(1);
            Mod res = a.operatorTimes(a).operatorPow(n / 2);
            if (n % 2 == 1) res = res.operatorTimes(a);
            return res;
        }

        public static Mod modPow(Mod a, int n) {
            if (n == 0) return new Mod(1);
            Mod res = modPow(a.operatorTimes(a), n / 2);
            if (n % 2 == 1) res = res.operatorTimes(a);
            return res;
        }

        public static Mod inv(Mod a) {
            return a.operatorPow(mod - 2);
        }

        public static Mod operatorDivide(Mod a, Mod b) {
            if (b.num == 0) throw new ArithmeticException("Division by zero");
            return a.operatorTimes(inv(b));
        }

        public static Mod operatorDivideLong(long a, Mod b) {
            return new Mod(a) / b;
        }

        public Mod operatorPlus(Mod b) {
            return new Mod((this.num + b.num) % mod);
        }

        public Mod operatorMinus(Mod b) {
            return new Mod((mod + this.num - b.num) % mod);
        }

        public Mod operatorTimes(Mod b) {
            return new Mod(((long)this.num * b.num) % mod);
        }

        public Mod operatorPow(int n) {
            if (n == 0) return new Mod(1);
            Mod res = this.operatorTimes(this).operatorPow(n / 2);
            if (n % 2 == 1) res = res.operatorTimes(this);
            return res;
        }
    }

    static void init() {
        fact[0] = new Mod(1);
        factinv[0] = new Mod(1);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_MOD_N - 1; i++) {
            fact[i + 1] = fact[i].operatorTimes(new Mod(i + 1));
            factinv[i + 1] = factinv[i].operatorTimes(new Mod(i + 1)).inv();
        }
    }

    static Mod comb(int a, int b) {
        return fact[a].operatorTimes(factinv[b]).operatorTimes(factinv[a - b]);
    }

    static class FastReader {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        public FastReader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
    }

    static void initMap() {
        int[] v = new int[9];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) v[i] = 0;
        for (int i = 3; i < 6; i++) v[i] = 1;
        for (int i = 6; i < 9; i++) v[i] = 1;
        int id = 0;
        do {
            int tt = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
                if (v[k] != 0) {
                    tt ^= (1 << k);
                }
            }
            mp.put(tt, id);
            id++;
        } while (nextPermutation(v));
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] v) {
        int i = v.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && v[i] >= v[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = v.length - 1;
        while (v[j] <= v[i]) j--;
        int temp = v[i];
        v[i] = v[j];
        v[j] = temp;
        for (int a = i + 1, b = v.length - 1; a < b; a++, b--) {
            int t = v[a];
            v[a] = v[b];
            v[b] = t;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static List<Mod> solve(Mod[][] pers, int al) {
        List<Mod> l_nums = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(1 << 20, new Mod(0)));
        for (int xx = 0; xx < (1 << 18); xx++) {
            int[][] haves = new int[3][6];
            Mod per = new Mod(1);
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                    int k = i * 6 + j;
                    if (((xx >> k) & 1) != 0) {
                        haves[i][j] = 1;
                        per = per.operatorTimes(pers[al + i][j]);
                    } else {
                        per = per.operatorTimes(new Mod(1)).operatorMinus(pers[al + i][j]);
                    }
                }
            }
            int flags = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
                if (haves[0][i] == 0) continue;
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                    if (haves[1][j] == 0) continue;
                    if (i == j) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
                        if (haves[2][k] == 0) continue;
                        if (i == k || j == k) continue;
                        int anum = 0;
                        anum ^= (1 << i);
                        anum ^= (1 << j);
                        anum ^= (1 << k);
                        flags |= (1 << mp.get(anum));
                    }
                }
            }
            l_nums.set(flags, l_nums.get(flags).operatorPlus(per));
        }
        return l_nums;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        FastReader fr = new FastReader();
        init();

        Mod[][] pers = new Mod[6][6];
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) {
                pers[i][j] = new Mod(0);
            }
        }

        initMap();

        int N = fr.nextInt();
        int s = 3 - (N + 1) / 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < s; i++) {
            pers[i][i] = new Mod(1);
        }
        for (int i = s; i < s + N; i++) {
            for (int j = s; j < s + N; j++) {
                int p = fr.nextInt();
                pers[i][j] = new Mod(p).operatorTimes(new Mod(1)).operatorDivide(new Mod(100));
            }
        }
        for (int i = s + N; i < 6; i++) {
            pers[i][i] = new Mod(1);
        }

        List<Mod> u_nums = solve(pers, 0);
        List<Mod> d_nums = solve(pers, 3);

        for (int x = 1; x < (1 << 20); x <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
                if ((i & x) == 0) {
                    d_nums.set(i ^ x, d_nums.get(i ^ x).operatorPlus(d_nums.get(i)));
                }
            }
        }

        Mod answer = new Mod(0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            if (u_nums.get(i).num != 0) {
                int need = 0;
                for (int x = 0; x < 20; x++) {
                    if (((i >> x) & 1) != 0) {
                        need |= (1 << (19 - x));
                    }
                }
                int pp = ((1 << 20) - 1) ^ i;
                Mod nanswer = u_nums.get(i).operatorTimes(new Mod(1).operatorMinus(d_nums.get(((1 << 20) - 1) ^ need)));
                answer = answer.operatorPlus(nanswer);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer.num);
    }
}
